yozakura.title: Built-in yozakura server (desktop control)

enabled.title: Shell control
enabled.description: Let models change the desktop through the yozakura tools; voice commands use it too.

target.title: Shell control runs on
target.description: Empty = the current chat model; agent:claude, agent:codex or agent:opencode to use a CLI agent.

systemPrompt.title: System prompt
systemPrompt.default: You control the user's Yozakura desktop shell through the yozakura MCP tools (config, presets, wallpaper, windows, workspaces, notifications, clipboard, screenshots, media, do-not-disturb). Inspect state with the read-only tools first, then make the smallest change that fulfils the request and say what you changed in one sentence.

enabled.title: Quick ask in the notch
enabled.description: Bind “AI Quick Ask” to ask from the notch without opening the sidebar.

model.title: Quick ask model
model.description: Model id (e.g. ollama:qwen3.5:9b); empty = current model

width.title: Quick ask width
width.description: Width of the card under the notch.

selection.description: Actions on the selected text (translate, explain, ...).

enabled.description: Bind “AI Selection Actions” to act on the selected text from any app.

language.title: Translate to
language.description: Target language of the Translate action ({language}).

output.title: Default result
output.description: Where results go when an action does not choose.

actions.title: Actions

default.prompt:
Translate the text below to {language}. If it already is {language}, translate it to Spanish. Reply with the translation only, keeping formatting.

{selection}

Explain the following clearly and briefly:

{selection}

Rewrite the text below to be clearer and more natural, same language and meaning. Reply with the rewritten text only.

{selection}

Fix bugs and obvious mistakes in this code. Reply with the corrected code only, no fences, no commentary.

{selection}

default.name: Explain error

Explain this error and how to fix it, briefly:

{clipboard}

default.name: Commit message
default.prompt:
Write a conventional commit message for this diff:

{clipboard}
